sourceBasis.preparationMethod: Selected historical facts were converted into structured app records and six practical inspector-note variants without copying source narrative into generator input.

noteVariants.text: Minor washout at the north, northeast and southwest dike wall. Floor-projection edge has moderate to severe corrosion; east tell-tale pipe is severely corroded. Southwest manhole pad tell-tale is plugged and non-compliant. Northwest three-inch nozzle has a temporary clamp and the internal neck is perforated at six o’clock. Northeast curb-angle underside has local coating failure; roof internal is coated but rusting. Floor has scattered 1–5 mm topside pits and three holes—two on plate 2.1, one on 3.3. Four-inch periphery band reads 5.0–6.1 mm. Sump lip 12.21–12.50, base 10.68, middle 10.74–11.70 mm; only spot readings at base because coating weakened signal. Random floor projection UT is 3–5 mm.

Dike washout minor N/NE/SW. Floor proj LE mod-severe corr; east tell-tale pipe severe corr. SW MH pad tell-tale plugged/non-compliant. NW 3 in nozzle temp clamp; internal neck perforated at 6 o’clock. NE curb underside local coating fail. Roof inside coated + rusting. Floor topside pits 1-5 mm + 3 holes: 2 at 2.1, 1 at 3.3. 4 in periphery UT 5.0-6.1. Sump lip 12.21-12.50, base 10.68, between 10.74-11.70 mm; base spot only due coating attenuation. Projection random UT 3-5 mm.

Floor projection spot UT came back 3 to 5 mm. Sump values: lip 12.21–12.50, base 10.68 and in-between 10.74–11.70 mm; base coating meant spot readings only. Floor has three holes, two at 2.1 and one at 3.3, with 1–5 mm topside pitting; the four-inch perimeter band is 5.0–6.1 mm. Roof inside is coated and rusting; northeast curb underside has local paint failure. Northwest three-inch nozzle is temporarily clamped and perforated internally at six. Southwest manhole tell-tale is plugged/non-compliant. East tell-tale pipe badly corroded, projection edge moderate to severe, and minor dike washout at N, NE and SW.

Dike wall has minor washout at north, northeast and southwest. At foundation, floor projection leading edge is moderate to severely corroded, and east tell-tale pipe is severe. On appurtenances—the southwest manhole reinforcement hole is plugged, not compliant. Northwest three-inch nozzle has a temporary clamp; the internal neck, at six o’clock, is perforated. Roof curb underside, northeast, local coating failure. Inside roof is coated but rusting. Floor: pits one to five millimetres and three holes—correction, two holes plate 2.1, one plate 3.3. Four-inch peripheral strip 5.0 to 6.1 mm. Sump lip 12.21 to 12.50, base 10.68, middle 10.74 to 11.70; base was spot only because coating attenuated signal. Projection random UT 3 to 5.

Dike N/NE/SW: minor washout. Foundation projection edge: moderate-severe corr. East tell-tale pipe: severe corr. SW manhole tell-tale: plugged / non-compliant. NW 3 in nozzle: temp clamp; inside neck perforated at 6 o’clock. Roof curb underside NE: local coating fail. Roof internal: coated, rusting. Floor: 1–5 mm topside pits; 3 holes (2 x plate 2.1, 1 x plate 3.3). Periphery 4 in band UT 5.0–6.1 mm. Sump: lip 12.21–12.50 / base 10.68 / intermediate 10.74–11.70 mm; base spot only. Projection UT random 3–5 mm.

Civil: dike has minor washout north, northeast and southwest; projection leading edge moderate-to-severe corrosion and east tell-tale pipe severe corrosion. Nozzles: southwest manhole tell-tale plugged/non-compliant; northwest 3-inch neck temporarily clamped and perforated internally at six o’clock. Roof: northeast curb underside local coating failure; internal roof coated with rusting. Floor: scattered 1–5 mm pits and three holes, two at plate 2.1 and one at 3.3. Four-inch peripheral band 5.0–6.1 mm. Sump readings: lip 12.21–12.50, base 10.68, middle 10.74–11.70 mm; base spot readings only due coating. Projection random UT 3–5 mm.
